div.textarea: Create a premium, modern, animation-ready flat vector SVG illustration for a SaaS agency hero section. Show a young web developer sitting at a clean minimalist workstation, working on a large desktop monitor displaying code, analytics dashboards, UI designs and marketing graphs. Use a friendly character with rounded proportions, expressive pose and clean facial features. Replace the realistic office with abstract organic yellow blobs, floating geometric shapes, dotted grids, scribbles, sparkles, curved lines and creative doodles. Use only black (#111111), white (#FFFFFF) and vibrant yellow (#FFC72C) as the primary color palette. Every object must be separated into individual SVG layers including head, hair, face, torso, left arm, right arm, hands, legs, shoes, chair, desk, monitor, keyboard, mouse, lamp, books, plant, floating UI cards, blobs, doodles and background elements. The illustration must be fully vector, scalable, clean, minimal, premium, and inspired by high-end startup websites. Prepare all layers for animation with subtle floating motion, breathing effect, blinking eyes, typing hands, monitor glow, moving UI cards, floating blobs, rotating doodles, mouse parallax and smooth infinite idle animation. Transparent background, no gradients, no raster images, no shadows, no text, no logos, no watermark, no clipart, no 3D, no photorealism, no excessive details. The final output must be a high-quality, production-ready, editable SVG optimized for Framer Motion, GSAP and Lottie animations.
